PrivacyPolicy.Title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.Introduction.Title: Introduction
PrivacyPolicy.Introduction.Content: This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our Identity Provider (IdP) service. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your data.
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.Title: Information We Collect
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.Description: We collect the following types of information to provide authentication and authorization services:
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.Authenticat: Authentication credentials (email, username, password hashes, multi-factor authentication data)
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.Profile: Profile information (name, email address, profile picture, preferred language)
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.LoginHistor: Login history and session information (timestamps, IP addresses, device information)
PrivacyPolicy.DataCollection.Technical: Technical data (browser type, operating system, authentication methods used)
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Title: How We Use Your Information
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Description: Your information is used for the following purposes:
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Authentication: Authenticating your identity and managing your account
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Authorization: Authorizing access to connected applications and services
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Security: Detecting and preventing security threats, fraud, and unauthorized access
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Audit: Maintaining audit logs for security and compliance purposes
PrivacyPolicy.DataUsage.Communication: Sending important security notifications and service updates
PrivacyPolicy.DataSharing.Title: Data Sharing
PrivacyPolicy.DataSharing.Content: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. Your information is only shared with applications and services you explicitly authorize through our single sign-on mechanism. We may share information when required by law or to protect our rights and the security of our users.
PrivacyPolicy.DataRetention.Title: Data Retention
PrivacyPolicy.DataRetention.Content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Login history and audit logs are retained according to our security and compliance policies. You may request deletion of your account, subject to legal and security requirements.
PrivacyPolicy.DataSecurity.Title: Data Security
PrivacyPolicy.DataSecurity.Content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure password storage, multi-factor authentication, regular security audits, and access controls. While we strive to protect your data, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Title: Your Rights
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Description: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Access: Access: View your personal information through your account profile
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Correction: Correction: Update or correct your information at any time
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Deletion: Deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Export: Export: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
PrivacyPolicy.UserRights.Objection: Objection: Withdraw consent for specific data processing activities
PrivacyPolicy.Cookies.Title: Cookies and Tracking
PrivacyPolicy.Cookies.Content: We use essential cookies to maintain your login session and security. These cookies are necessary for the service to function and cannot be disabled. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
PrivacyPolicy.Changes.Title: Changes to This Policy
PrivacyPolicy.Changes.Content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes through our service or via email. Your continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
PrivacyPolicy.Contact.Title: Contact Us
PrivacyPolicy.Contact.Content: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact your system administrator or the data protection officer for your organization.
